title: The Heart of the Jolly Seagull
moral: True treasure is friendship and shared experiences.

scenes.summary: Captain Flint and his crew begin a treasure journey.
scenes.text: Captain Jack Flint sailed with his crew on The Jolly Seagull. He announced a journey to Treasure Island, and the crew set sail with excitement.
scenes.image_prompt: pirate captain with crew on ship holding map excited cartoon children’s book style

scenes.summary: The crew explores a mysterious island and faces uncertainty.
scenes.text: They reached a misty island filled with strange sounds and unknown dangers as they searched for treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: pirates entering misty island jungle with curious expressions cartoon style

scenes.summary: The crew finds a key and explores a hidden cave.
scenes.text: Tommy found a golden key, and the crew used it to open a hidden cave. Inside, they solved puzzles and avoided traps together.
scenes.image_prompt: boy holding golden key with pirates entering cave solving puzzles cartoon style

scenes.summary: They discover treasure and an important message.
scenes.text: They found a chest full of treasure, but inside was a compass and a note explaining the true treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: pirates opening treasure chest with compass and note glowing cartoon style

scenes.summary: The crew understands the value of friendship.
scenes.text: Captain Flint realized friendship was the real treasure, and the crew sailed away happily together.
scenes.image_prompt: pirate crew sailing happily together at sunset cartoon style

story: Captain Jack Flint sailed with his crew on The Jolly Seagull in search of treasure. They reached a mysterious island where Tommy found a golden key. The crew explored a hidden cave, solving puzzles and facing challenges together. Inside, they found treasure but also a note explaining that true treasure is friendship and shared adventures. The crew realized the value of their bond and sailed away happily, ready for more adventures.
